arguments.code: var desktopImages = await page.locator('img').evaluateAll(imgs => imgs.map(img => ({src:img.currentSrc, complete:img.complete, width:img.naturalWidth}))); await page.locator('.menu-button').click(); var panelVisible = await page.locator('.index-panel').evaluate(el => getComputedStyle(el).opacity); await page.locator('.rsvp').click(); var rsvpCopy = await page.locator('.rsvp').innerText(); await browser.close(); nodeRepl.write(JSON.stringify({images:desktopImages.map(x=>x.width),panelVisible,rsvpCopy}));
